correlation_basis.rule: same_game_correlation = 1: every same-game position decision.js creates is a spread and the same side at two books is the same bet (DEV phi of the same team covering at lines 3 points apart: 0.8758)

market_limits.note: at current scale book limits are not the constraint; per-book limits, liquidity and price impact are recorded here when stakes grow (brief §50)

note: Derived by the pre-registered rules of docs/cfb-decision/POLICY_PREREG.md from the DEV walk-forward policy study (docs/cfb-decision/POLICY.md). Betting is disabled: turning it on is a person's promotion decision through the section-86 gate, which this policy fails. Under the frozen calibration artifact the calibrated (curve-mapped) EV is -0.0317 at every price, so no quote clears min_ev and the BET region is empty.

provenance.min_ev: declared floor on the calibrated EV (prereg §5)
provenance.min_football_confidence / max_ensemble_s: declared safety bounds carried from v0: not validated filters
provenance.min_probability_edge: edge candidate, final DEV plateau choice (prereg §3, §5)

wait.note: disabled: no DEV evidence that waiting pays (prereg §5); the other keys are the declared decision.js defaults, used only if a later policy enables WAIT
